be suspicious of strangers: My grandmother tends to be suspicious of strangers and never opens her door, worried that they might be thieves.
我奶奶往往對陌生人懷有疑心，從不開門，擔心他們可能是小偷。
suspicious circumstances: The rich businessman died under suspicious circumstances, so the police have started a murder investigation.
那位富商在可疑的情況下死亡，所以警方已經展開謀殺案調查。
a suspicious look: When I said I had finished my homework, my mother gave me a suspicious look, as if she did not believe me.
當我說我已經寫完功課時，媽媽給了我一個懷疑的眼神，彷彿她不相信我。
highly suspicious: The bank thought the large late-night payments were highly suspicious and stopped the account immediately.
銀行認為那些深夜的大筆付款非常可疑，並立刻凍結了帳戶。
a suspicious package: Police asked everyone to leave the airport after a suspicious package was found near the check-in counter.
在報到櫃台附近發現一個可疑包裹後，警方要求所有人離開機場。
sustainable development: The government promises sustainable development, growing the economy without destroying forests or polluting rivers for future generations.
政府承諾推動永續發展，在發展經濟的同時不為後代破壞森林或汙染河川。
sustainable energy: Solar and wind power are forms of sustainable energy that will not run out like coal or oil.
太陽能和風力是永續能源的形式，不會像煤炭或石油那樣用完。
a sustainable lifestyle: To live a sustainable lifestyle, she rides a bike, eats less meat, and avoids buying plastic products.
為了過永續的生活方式，她騎腳踏車、少吃肉，並避免購買塑膠製品。
sustainable growth: The company wants sustainable growth over many years rather than quick profits that disappear the next year.
這家公司想要多年可持續的成長，而不是隔年就消失的快速獲利。
environmentally sustainable: The new library is environmentally sustainable, using rainwater and solar panels to reduce its impact on nature.
這座新圖書館是環境永續的，利用雨水和太陽能板來減少對自然的影響。
a swift response: The government's swift response to the typhoon helped thousands of families get food and shelter within hours.
政府對颱風迅速的回應，讓數千個家庭在幾小時內就得到食物和住所。
swift action: Thanks to the nurse's swift action, the man who fainted on the train received help within seconds.
多虧了護理師迅速的行動，那位在火車上昏倒的男子在幾秒內就得到救助。
a swift decision: With only one minute left in the game, the coach made a swift decision to change the goalkeeper.
比賽只剩一分鐘時，教練做出果斷迅速的決定，換掉守門員。
swift to criticize: Online users were swift to criticize the singer, posting angry comments within minutes of her mistake on stage.
網友急於批評那位歌手，在她舞台失誤後幾分鐘內就貼出憤怒的留言。
a swift recovery: Everyone in our class sent cards to our teacher, wishing her a swift recovery after her operation.
我們班上每個人都寄卡片給老師，祝她手術後迅速康復。
be symbolic of: In many cultures, the white dove is said to be symbolic of peace and often appears on posters against war.
在許多文化中，白鴿被認為象徵和平，並常出現在反戰海報上。
a symbolic gesture: Planting one tree is only a symbolic gesture, but it shows that the company cares about the environment.
種一棵樹只是象徵性的舉動，但它顯示這家公司關心環境。
symbolic meaning: In Chinese culture, the color red has a strong symbolic meaning, representing good luck and happiness.
在中華文化中，紅色有強烈的象徵意義，代表好運和喜悅。
a symbolic victory: Winning the small vote was only a symbolic victory, because the law still could not be changed.
贏得那場小投票只是象徵性的勝利，因為法律仍然無法被改變。
purely symbolic: The one-dollar salary the president accepts is purely symbolic, since he is already very rich.
總統只領一元薪水純屬象徵性，因為他本來就非常富有。
be sympathetic to the idea: Most teachers seem to be sympathetic to the idea of a later school start, but some parents worry about work schedules.
大多數老師似乎支持較晚上學的這個想法，但有些家長擔心上班時間。
a sympathetic ear: Whenever I feel stressed, my best friend always offers a sympathetic ear and listens without judging me.
每當我感到壓力大時，我最好的朋友總是當個願意傾聽的人，聽我說話而不批評我。
a sympathetic character: The thief in the movie is a sympathetic character because he steals only to buy medicine for his sick son.
電影裡的小偷是個討人喜歡的角色，因為他偷東西只是為了替生病的兒子買藥。
a sympathetic response: When I told my teacher my dog had died, she gave a sympathetic response and let me hand in my homework later.
當我告訴老師我的狗死了，她給了我同情的回應，並讓我晚點交作業。
a systematic approach: Instead of studying randomly, take a systematic approach: review one unit a day and test yourself every weekend.
與其隨意讀書，不如採取系統化的方法：每天複習一個單元，每週末自我測驗。
systematic errors: The scientist found systematic errors in the results because the machine always measured two degrees too high.
科學家在結果中發現系統性誤差，因為那台機器總是多測了兩度。
systematic abuse: The report revealed systematic abuse of workers at the factory, where managers had forced them to work without pay for years.
這份報告揭露了工廠對工人有系統的虐待，經理多年來強迫他們無薪工作。
a systematic review: Doctors did a systematic review, carefully comparing fifty studies to find out whether the new drug really works.
醫生們做了一項系統性回顧，仔細比較五十項研究，以查明這種新藥是否真的有效。
